acs.text_first_line: Scenario: AC1 Summary shown (legacy RWB-E2-028 AC1)
Scenario: AC2 Acceptance measured (legacy RWB-E2-028 AC2)
Scenario: AC4 Correction without a reason (legacy RWB-E2-028 AC4)
Scenario: AC5 The decision cannot be recorded (legacy RWB-E2-028 AC5)
Scenario: AC6 Feedback given twice (legacy RWB-E2-028 AC6)
Scenario: AC7 A case outside the user's scope (legacy RWB-E2-028 AC7)
Scenario: AC8 A segment still in shadow (legacy RWB-E2-028 AC8)
Scenario: AC9 Stale input (legacy RWB-E2-028 AC9)

ops_provided: GET /api/recovery/agent/v1/cases/{caseId}/agent-outputs: the L1 agent outputs of a case, an empty array for a case with no L1 output or a segment in shadow (API-P10-010 of TSD P10 Agent runtime v2 T-A.1; shape fixed by RWB-P10-E2028-CON)
POST /api/recovery/agent/v1/agent-runs/{runId}/feedback: the owner's verdict on the summary item, with the If-Match row version (API-P10-011 of the same T-A.1; shape fixed by RWB-P10-E2028-CON)
ops_consumed: rwb-case GET /api/recovery/case/v1/cases/{caseId}: the case facts, the owner and the team scope (RWB-P3-E1035-CON)
rwb-case the case-decision proposal operation: the verdict proposed to the case record (path not named by a source; RWB-P3-E1035-CON; GAP-0623)
rwb-case GET /api/recovery/case/v1/admin/lists/{listCode}: LOV-PRODUCT, LOV-REGION, LOV-AUTONOMY, LOV-FEEDBACK, LOV-DECISION, LOV-AGENT and LOV-AGENT-RUN (RWB-P3-E1043-CON)
rwb-decision GET /api/recovery/decision/v1/decision-log/{entryId}: the sealed entry of a verdict (RWB-P7-E1027-CON)
rwb-source-data GET /api/recovery/source-data/v1/freshness: the business date compared with agent_run.data_as_of (the GET /freshness of Arch v5 slide 15; GAP-0622; ASM-0918)
events_published: rwb.agent.AgentRunCompleted.v1 (EV-28) on rwb.agent.events.v1 with the retry topic and the .dlt topic (DP-09)
rwb.agent.AgentFeedbackRecorded.v1 on rwb.agent.events.v1 with the retry topic and the .dlt topic (name fixed under §R4; GAP-0623)
DecisionRecorded, the decision-record type of the library, on rwb.decision-record.v1 with retry and .dlt (DP-03; ASM-0922)
workflows: AgentRunWorkflow (workflow, event-started, one execution per case and event, queue rwb-agent, namespace rwb-recovery; restated from the run path)
